formulas.effective_training_hours: scheduled_hours * attendance * capacity_factor * instructor_quality_factor * facility_quality_factor * equipment_factor * health_factor * recovery_factor * relevance_factor * difficulty_fit_factor
formulas.skill_gain: consume development units point-by-point until the routine training ceiling or credit exhaustion

progression_thresholds.rule: Routine training may raise a capability to 160 but may not create advancement beyond it. Capability above 160 requires evidence-backed exact-person breakthrough resolution or a more exceptional subsystem. Generic training, elapsed calendar time, autonomous review count, or banked practice cannot create legendary, transcendent, or god-tier capability.

breakthrough_rules.160_to_169: B-rank-or-higher mission-grade experience, or genuinely dangerous exact combat
breakthrough_rules.185_plus: requires a specific exceptional subsystem; generic mission/combat evidence is insufficient

named_service_development.rule: Active exact named shinobi without a lawful exact-team training owner receive bounded service-development opportunities at person-continuity reviews. Exact team training takes precedence. Academy students, civilians, retired or dead characters, and the authenticated player are excluded. Historical debt is never inferred during ordinary play and may only be settled by an explicit guarded repair.

autonomous_scheduling_rule: Routine team-training volume is a default opportunity, not guaranteed activity. Active missions or team assignments preempt it; the team must be active, members must be healthy and co-located, and a registered non-player instructor must be available. Player characters are never silently trained by an autonomous team review.
promotion: qualified_subset_transfer only; rank requires institutional/experience gates in addition to capability
batch_equivalence: batch only while all causal inputs remain unchanged; split at any causal change
